For pair production \(\gamma\gamma \to e^+e^-\), the threshold condition for a head-on collision is

\[
E_\gamma \epsilon \ge (m_e c^2)^2
\]

where \(\epsilon \sim 10^{-3}\,\text{eV}\) is the average CMB photon energy and \(m_e c^2 \approx 0.511\,\text{MeV} = 5.11\times 10^5\,\text{eV}\).

Thus,

\[
E_\gamma \ge \frac{(5.11\times 10^5\,\text{eV})^2}{10^{-3}\,\text{eV}}
\approx 2.6\times 10^{14}\,\text{eV}
= 2.6\times 10^5\,\text{GeV}.
\]

Answer: B
